description: Closes #298 (Gmail leg) — the first connector agent_flow case. Composio is disabled in evals, so the Gmail agent normally boots with zero tools; this case relies on the eval-stub GMAIL_FETCH_EMAILS tool (helixis.evals.connector_stub_tools) injected by the harness, with its _impl mocked to return a recent-inbox summary. Asserts the happy path: a 'most recent email' ask one-shots the fetch tool and the reply surfaces the message (the Gmail prompt says fetch-and-present without follow-up questions). Quality/K-of-N assertions — the Gmail agent legitimately surfaces inbox contents to the user; no must-never applies.
